notes.title: FaceFun V2.0 has been updated！Support VRM And Live2d Import
notes.content:
The software now supports the [h1][b]import [/b][/h1]of [h1][b]VRM[/b][/h1] and [h1][b]Live2d[/b][/h1] models at the same time. 
It comes with more than 40 VRM models and 2 Live2d models. 
More content will be updated in the future. 
Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Record videos using FaceFun and OBS.
notes.content:
Add new feature：
   With the excellent recording software OBS, you can add FaceFun characters anywhere you record your video.
